trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: Initiate outbound call and ask for verification factors
steps.text: नमस्ते, मैं hospital से बात कर रहा हूँ। आपकी surgery के pre-authorisation का decision आ गया है। Verification के लिए, कृपया अपना patient ID, registered नाम और date of birth confirm करें।

steps.purpose: Provide patient ID and verification factors
steps.text: मेरा patient ID PT-2009 है, नाम रमेश है, और date of birth पंद्रह May 1980 है।

steps.purpose: Ask for policy and procedure details
steps.text: Thank you रमेश जी। क्या आप मुझे अपना policy number, procedure का नाम और room category बता सकते हैं ताकि मैं details देख सकूँ?

steps.purpose: Provide policy, procedure, and room details
steps.text: मेरा policy number POL-55509 है, procedure hernia repair है और room private था।

steps.purpose: Estimate procedure cost for private room

steps.text: रमेश जी, आपका private room के लिए hernia repair का package estimate 1,50,000 है। लेकिन आपकी policy का बचा हुआ balance सिर्फ 1,20,000 है। इसलिए insurer ने 1,20,000 तक ही approve किया है。
यह कैसे हो सकता है? मेरा sum insured तो 3,00,000 है। Balance 1,20,000 कैसे बचा? आपने यह figure कहाँ से निकाला?

steps.purpose: Address user's scepticism about the balance
steps.text: Sir, StarHealth से जो details आई हैं, उसके मुताबिक आपका current balance 1,20,000 ही बचा है। अगर आपने इस साल कोई और claim किया है, तो balance amount कम हो जाता है।

steps.purpose: Accept explanation and ask for alternative
steps.text: हाँ, पिछले महीने एक छोटा claim था। ठीक है, अगर मैं general ward में shift हो जाऊँ, तो package कितना होगा?

steps.purpose: Estimate procedure cost for general ward
Return procedure cost estimate for general ward
Provide new estimate and propose next step
steps.text: मैं check कर लेता हूँ। General ward के लिए hernia repair का package estimate 1,10,000 है। यह आपके 1,20,000 के balance के अंदर आता है, तो हम इस नई amount के साथ request भेज सकते हैं।
अच्छा, फिर ठीक है। आप general ward के लिए नया preauth request submit कर दीजिए।
आपका request submit हो गया है। Reference id PRE-9912 है। StarHealth की तरफ से 4 घंटे में decision आ जाएगा।
ठीक है, मैं wait करता हूँ।

ir.terminal_condition: Pre-authorisation submitted with an id and the insurer's decision window stated.

variant_findings.reason: The user asks for the package cost if they shift to a general ward, presenting a decision point with multiple plausible tools. The agent correctly selects 'estimate_procedure_cost' over submitting the request.

variant_findings.reason: The agent fails the grounding requirement by hallucinating that a pre-auth decision has arrived (e1) and that the insurer has approved 120,000 (e11), neither of which is supported by any tool output.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The agent claims in e1 that a pre-authorisation decision has arrived, and in e11 that the insurer has approved 120,000. There is no tool output supporting either claim. This also violates the forbidden action against stating an approval that no tool result supports.
issues.repair_instruction: Change the premise of the outbound call to initiating a pre-authorisation for an upcoming planned surgery (scenario: planned_surgery_cashless), since the tools do not support fetching an existing decision. The agent should state the package cost and the available balance, explaining the shortfall without claiming that the insurer has already made an approval decision.

issues.detail: In e1, the agent states they are calling because a pre-authorisation decision has arrived, but in e5, the agent asks the user for their policy number and procedure. If a decision had arrived, the hospital would already have these details.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite the conversation so the agent is calling to gather details to submit the initial pre-authorisation request, making the request for policy and procedure details logically sound.

verification.summary: The conversation fails because the agent hallucinates an existing pre-authorisation decision and an approval amount that are not supported by any tool outputs, violating both the grounding variant and business rules. The premise of the call is also logically inconsistent. A full regeneration is required to align the scenario with the available tools.
